description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.
The domain name or IP address.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
检测类型。取值：
- **api**：表示API资产的域名列表。
- **abnormal**：表示风险的域名列表。
- **event**：表示安全事件的域名列表。
description.en:
The detection type. Valid values:
- **api**: the domain name list of API assets.
- **abnormal**: the domain name list of risks.
- **event**: the domain name list of security events.

title.zh: 查询API安全检测的域名列表
title.en: Query the domain name list for API security detection

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-matched-hosts --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-x0r37plpl0g --matched-host bc.aliyun.com --page-number 1 --page-size 8 --type event --cluster-id 433 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekz5qqo7jthcsa --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
